name: app-oviah-case-study-title-slide-with-tags-and-credits
title: OVIAH case study title slide: wordmark, category tags and full team credit line beside a glossy 3D app icon
whatItIs: A white cover with 'Women's Health & Period Tracking App' eyebrow, the large OVIAH wordmark, tagline, a 'UX/UI Case Study' label with four pink-outlined tag pills (UX Research, UX Strategy, UI/UX Design, Prototyping), a full team credit line, and the same glossy 3D app-icon tile with badge on the right.
whatItMeans: Professional and scannable; tag pills let a viewer instantly see the case study's scope before reading further.
techniques: List a case study's discipline scope as tag pills.
Credit the full team on the opening slide, not just the close.
Bookend a case study with the same 3D icon tile at start and end.

vocabulary.definition: A small rounded label naming one category or skill.
Repeating a visual element at both the start and end of a piece.
